Here is the corrected test suite in xUnit Test Cases notation:

```artifact
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
import json

class TestDoorstopRequirements(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_store_requirements(self):
        # Arrange
        requirements = {"req1": "desc1", "req2": "desc2"}
        doorstop = Mock()
        doorstop.store_requirements.return_value = True

        # Act
        result = doorstop.store_requirements(requirements)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)
        doorstop.store_requirements.assert_called_once_with(requirements)

    def test_handle_change_management(self):
        # Arrange
        req_id = "REQ012"
        doorstop = Mock()
        doorstop.handle_change_management.return_value = True

        # Act
        result = doorstop.handle_change_management(req_id)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)
        doorstop.handle_change_management.assert_called_once_with(req_id)

    def test_associate_requirements_changes(self):
        # Arrange
        req_id = "REQ013"
        dev_id = "dev1"
        doorstop = Mock()
        doorstop.associate_requirements_changes.return_value = True

        # Act
        result = doorstop.associate_requirements_changes(req_id, dev_id)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)
        doorstop.associate_requirements_changes.assert_called_once_with(req_id, dev_id)

    def test_scalability(self):
        # Arrange
        num_reqs = 1000
        doorstop = Mock()
        doorstop.store_requirements.side_effect = [True] * num_reqs

        # Act
        for i in range(num_reqs):
            doorstop.store_requirements("req" + str(i))

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(num_reqs, doorstop.store_requirements.call_count)

    def test_lightweight_installation(self):
        # Arrange
        doorstop = Mock()
        doorstop.install.return_value = True

        # Act
        result = doorstop.install()

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)
        doorstop.install.assert_called_once_with()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
